messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — after the v3.9 merge we're seeing a p99 jump on SSE streaming from ~80ms to ~220ms for short messages.
perf-bot: perf-tests/nightly: eventstream-suite p99 +65% (baseline 80ms -> 220ms). Job: ci/bench/eventstream/271234
chris: I pulled a local perf build and ran a limited trace. big hotspot in bulk_encoder::serialize_large_chunk (60% CPU in that symbol). also see syscall spike around socket write.
priya: Noted. The merge changed ephemeral prefetch threshold (prefetch.window) from 4 -> 8 and landed a small buffer coalescing change in protocol/handshake.go — maybe interacting badly with kernel-autoselect.
maya: Kernel autoselect started choosing kernel 'vec_align32_v2' for sequences >64 which does an extra aligned copy path. If SSE buffer gets prefilled by prefetch we might be duplicating work + blocking flush.
alex: Repro steps: run ci/bench/eventstream with --trace=net,encoder and look for blocked writer after encode_large_chunk. Sample trace:
```
encode_large_chunk -> bulk_encoder::serialize_large_chunk  (60%)
-> vec_align32_v2::transform  (12%)
-> syscall:write (blocked 80ms)
```
priya: I started a bisect between commits abc123...def456 (the prefetch change) and ghi789...jkl012 (handshake coalesce). Early results pin the latency increase to abc123 (prefetch change).
perf-bot: perf-bisect: suspected commit abc123 increased p99 by +58% (confidence 93%).
chris: OK that's actionable. Two hypotheses: 1) prefetch increases SSE occupancy causing larger syscalls, or 2) kernel choice + alignment path causes extra memcopies. I'll instrument kernel selection path and add a metric for prefetch-triggered-prefill.
maya: Can we toggle prefetch.window back to 4 in a quick revert and run the perf job? If that regresses back we can ship a targeted revert.
release-bot: rollout status: hold placed on release/v3.9 pending perf investigation (:warning:).
alex: I'll open PR to revert the prefetch change now (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321) and queue the perf job. Chris, can you add flamegraph and a heap/alloc profile to the perf run?
chris: On it. Also adding a kernel-routing log gate to capture which kernel gets picked for a given seq_len.
priya: If revert doesn't fix it, fallback plan: prevent vec_align32_v2 for SSE routes via kernel-blacklist for 24h and ship a patch.
alex: Thanks team. We'll update here when CI perf job finishes. Short term: hold rollout; mid term: revert + observability; long term: add a regression test to perf suite that runs short-message SSE workloads.
perf-bot: perf-tests/nightly finished: eventstream-suite p99 reduced to 85ms after revert candidate branch run (prelim).
